; Hide Home Logo - v2
; Removes the centered "reMarkable" wordmark from the home screen header.
; The logo is made transparent (opacity 0), not deleted: tapping the empty
; centre of the header still jumps to the root of My files, as before.
; v2: no `continue` statement, retries for ~10 s in case the header builds late,
;     matches the logo by source OR by being the only Image centred in the header,
;     and logs to the xovi debug output as [hideHomeLogo].
; Lesson (verified on device 2026-11-25): v1 (single scan in Component.onCompleted, used `continue`)
;   loaded but did not hide the logo; v2 works. Untested which change fixed it, so keep both:
;   avoid `continue` in inserted JS, and retry with a Timer instead of a one-shot onCompleted.
; Additive: one INSERT into FocusScope#header, no REPLACE, so it coexists with
; fieldWeather.qmd, hideDevModeIcon.qmd and Nave.
; Target firmware: 3.29.1.0 (hashtab 3.29.1.0)
; Remove: delete this file from /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/ and run /home/root/xovi/start.

; /qml/device/view/navigator/ContentHeader.qml
AFFECT [[16664384747789373392]]
    ; FocusScope#header
    TRAVERSE ?#[[7082729395218]]

        LOCATE AFTER ALL INSERT {
            Item {
                id: hideHomeLogo
                width: 0
                height: 0
                property int tries: 0
                property bool done: false

                function log(msg) {
                    console.log("[hideHomeLogo] " + msg);
                }

                function isLogo(item) {
                    var s = "" + item.source;
                    if (s.indexOf("logo_remarkable") >= 0) return true;
                    var t = "" + item;
                    if (t.indexOf("Image") === 0 || t.indexOf("QQuickImage") === 0) {
                        if (s.indexOf("logo") >= 0) return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                }

                function apply() {
                    var kids = header.children;
                    var hits = 0;
                    for (var i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) {
                        if (isLogo(kids[i])) {
                            kids[i].opacity = 0;
                            hits = hits + 1;
                        }
                    }
                    tries = tries + 1;
                    log("pass " + tries + ": " + kids.length + " children, hid " + hits);
                    if (hits > 0) done = true;
                }

                Timer {
                    interval: 1000
                    repeat: true
                    running: { return hideHomeLogo.done === false && hideHomeLogo.tries < 10; }
                    onTriggered: hideHomeLogo.apply()
                }

                Component.onCompleted: {
                    hideHomeLogo.log("loaded");
                    hideHomeLogo.apply();
                }
            }
        }

    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
